# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: South Korea1970 national programme.
# Generated by tools/COLDWAR_KOR_1970_concept/COLDWAR_KOR_runtime.py.
COLDWAR_KOR_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_office_epoch = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_focus }
				}
				load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_focus
			}
			if = {
				limit = { date < 1973.3.29 }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_vietnam_commitment_active
			}
			COLDWAR_KOR_politics_initialize = yes
			COLDWAR_KOR_foreign_initialize = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_KOR_sync_politics = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_sync_politics = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_sync_running }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_sync_running
		COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = yes
		COLDWAR_KOR_foreign_refresh = yes
		COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_sync_running
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_ensure_labour_representation = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_lawful_labour_bargaining }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = labour_unions }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_saved_labour_opinion
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = labour_unions_opinion }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_labour_opinion_before = labour_unions_opinion }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_saved_labour_opinion
			}
			add_ideas = labour_unions
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_saved_labour_opinion }
				set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = COLDWAR_KOR_labour_opinion_before }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_saved_labour_opinion
			}
			initialize_internal_faction_dynamic_modifiers = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = labour_unions
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_labour_recognition_paid }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 10 }
			change_labour_unions_opinion = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_labour_recognition_paid
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_reconcile_institutions = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_us_alliance_assurance_signed has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_us_drawdown_signed }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_start_alliance_resolved
	}
	COLDWAR_KOR_ensure_labour_representation = yes
}
COLDWAR_KOR_weekly = {
	COLDWAR_KOR_initialize = yes
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized }
		COLDWAR_KOR_politics_daily = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_civil_nuclear_paid
				is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_nuclear_energy
				check_variable = { nuclear_reactors > 0 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_resolved }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_resolved
			COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_KOR_sync_politics = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_action_energy_project_options = { COLDWAR_nuc_ensure_modifiers = yes COLDWAR_cop_update = yes }
COLDWAR_KOR_action_existing_civil_nuclear_projects = { COLDWAR_nuc_ensure_modifiers = yes COLDWAR_cop_update = yes COLDWAR_calculate_nuclear_development_budget = yes }
COLDWAR_KOR_action_existing_energy_purchase_options = { COLDWAR_nuc_ensure_modifiers = yes COLDWAR_cop_update = yes }
COLDWAR_KOR_action_existing_guest_worker_contracts = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme }
		}
		add_ideas = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme
	}
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_worker_agreements_open
}
